QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] To Tynerum
QuestInfo.0: Have a conversation with Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia
QuestInfo.1: Grendel the Really Old asked you to investigate Crimsonheart Castle. Use the #rDimnsional Mirror#k in any town to get there.
QuestInfo.2: You have arrived at Crimsonheart Castle.

0.0: This book has become a medium to open the Dimensional Mirrors in town. The portal to Crimsonheart Castle is now available.

yes.0: I'm counting on you. We need more details on Tynerum.\r\n#b(Take the Dimensional Mirror to Crimsonheart Castle.)#k

no.0: I don't blame you for your hesitation, but I would ask you to reconsider.

1.0: Who are you?! Stay back! We're not going to go easy!

yes.0: Wait... are you here to help us? How can I trust you? We had no way of telling anybody we were stuck in here.

npc.0: Take the #bDimensional Mirror#k to Crimsonheart Castle from any town, and find out more about Tynerum.
